topics.title: Stern Show Features Guests
topics.summary: The broadcast included a segment featuring Sirhan Serhan and Vinny Mazzio Jr., discussing marijuana use. Celebrity guests such as Bill Cosby, Joan Rivers, Rodney Dangerfield, Robin Williams, Elaine Boozler, and others appeared in an anniversary special at the cafe Wahoo.

topics.title: Six Sixteen Ninety-Two WISP Anniversary Show
topics.summary: During a show celebrating the anniversary of Six Sixteen Ninety-Two rock WISP, hosts engage in chaotic segments including phone calls with confused listeners discussing business and bathroom requests. They discuss their musicians Tim & Frank, an Ovation guitar gift, recollections of past prank calls featuring Gary Sandy, and stories about backstage encounters at a club in A.

topics.title: NBC Songwriting and Commercial Critique
topics.summary: During a recording session, Howard writes an NBC song with John Hayes that includes a crude commercial criticizing their general manager. The song features offensive lyrics about NBC employees and company culture, culminating in chaotic musical segments filled with nonsensical phrases referencing various figures within the organization.

topics.title: Tim and Frank Dress as Ladies on the Radio
topics.summary: During the show, Tim records music all night while preparing to dress with Frank in ladies’ attire for their upcoming TV appearance. They will wear cha-cha heels and discuss celebrity guests including Rob Weller who teaches popsicle stick crafts and frequently interrupts discussions, alongside other shows like 'Win Lose or Draw' featuring Vicki Lawrence.

topics.title: Backless Dresses and Private Parts
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Lonnie Anderson discusses his companion’s preference for dresses that expose her back rather than her front, alongside specialized bras designed to accommodate this style.
